1.why: UI uses a clean sans-serif typeface with clear letter spacing and comfortable line spacing across all screens.

2.why: Instructions use sentence case with no italics, all-caps, or dense paragraph blocks.

3.why: Content is in a single-column card layout with large inputs and buttons that fits mobile width cleanly.

4.why: Copy is consistently short and plain, e.g. 'Sign in to begin. Take your time.' and 'Enter the same contact details again.'

5.why: Login fields show explicit demo examples (marcus@example.com, 07123 456789, MarcusDemo!54) of expected input.

6.why: No screen requires reading a long text block; only brief labels and one-line hints are shown.

7.why: No long codes or secrets are presented in any screenshot, and no copy-to-clipboard control appears.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry is offered on any screen.

9.why: Standard email, phone, and password inputs are used, which normally allow browser autofill and password managers.

10.why: Header shows 'Step X of 6' plus title, and the blue primary button is the clearest action on each screen.

11.why: Each screen has exactly one primary CTA (Sign in and continue / Confirm my identity).

12.why: Success is stated plainly ('You are signed in. Next, confirm your identity'), but the later failure only shows a cryptic banner.

13.why: UI explicitly says you can retry any step and correct details; code reveal/re-request is not reached.

14.why: The only error shown is 'Invalid array length', which neither explains the problem in plain terms nor how to fix it.

15.why: Screens state 'No reading timer', 'Take your time', and allow retry with no visible countdown or time pressure.
